name: Den Frie Centre of Contemporary Art (Den Frie Udstillingsbygning)
funding: Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond), City of Copenhagen, artist association dues; artist-owned non-profit.
watch: Founded in 1891 by artists as an independent revolt against the official Salon; artist-owned and operated to this day.

name: O—Overgaden Institut for Samtidskunst
funding: Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond), City of Copenhagen, private non-profit foundations; registered non-profit.
watch: Founded in 1986 on Christianshavn canal; non-profit institution dedicated to experimental Danish and international artists.

name: MUU Helsinki Contemporary Art Centre
funding: Arts Promotion Centre Finland (Taike), City of Helsinki, Finnish Cultural Foundation; non-profit artists' association.
watch: Founded in 1987 by artists; promotes experimental and non-traditional art forms, sound art, performance, and video art.

name: Kling & Bang
funding: Icelandic Visual Arts Fund (Myndlistarsjóður), City of Reykjavík, artist members; independent artist-run collective.

name: Nýló (The Living Art Museum / Nýlistasafnið)
funding: Ministry of Culture and Business Affairs Iceland, City of Reykjavík, member association; artist-run museum foundation.
watch: Founded in 1978 by visual artists as an artist-run museum and archive for experimental and Fluxus art; Marshall House.

name: Flutgraben
funding: Self-governing artist cooperative dues, Senate Department for Culture Berlin project grants; non-profit association.
watch: Former bus repair depot on the Spree / Flutgraben canal; self-governing non-profit providing affordable studios for 50+ artists since 1997.

name: Künstlerhaus Stuttgart
funding: City of Stuttgart Cultural Office, State of Baden-Württemberg; artist-run non-profit association.

name: Lothringer 13 Halle
watch: Former machine factory in Haidhausen; non-profit municipal institution with rotating independent curatorial teams and zero admission fees.

name: basis Frankfurt
funding: City of Frankfurt Cultural Office (Kulturamt Frankfurt), Hessian Ministry for Science and the Arts; non-profit association.
watch: Non-profit production and exhibition platform in Gutleutviertel; houses over 130 artist studios and international residency exchanges.

name: La Station
funding: Ville de Nice, DRAC PACA (Ministère de la Culture), Région Sud; artist-run non-profit association.
watch: Artist-run space founded in 1996 in the former municipal refrigerated slaughterhouses (Les Abattoirs); pure artistic self-management.

name: Le Confort Moderne
funding: Ministère de la Culture (DRAC Nouvelle-Aquitaine), Ville de Poitiers, Région Nouvelle-Aquitaine; non-profit association.
